ops.title: Run required evidence
ops.imperative: Run the handoff's full crew-launcher test file, atomic-save confirmatory test, git diff --check, and heartbeat call-site search. Record exact outputs in the durable result. Advance only after all command evidence passes.

postconditions.statement: Diff is whitespace-clean and heartbeat seam audit is recorded

ops.title: Record and commit result
ops.imperative: Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT with scope, red/green/full evidence, map impact, workflow feedback, and commit locally. Attest c1 after independently confirming the result and commit exist; advance only then.

postconditions.statement: Durable result written and local commit created
